quote.text:
New Trump Launch

It's not a fake!

Earlier, media reported that Donald Trump's Truth Social was planning to issue a token.

Rumor has it that the $TRUTH token will launch on the Robinhood Chain, with a 1B total supply and an initial circulating supply of 500M.

300M is allocated to the liquidity pool, while 200M is set aside for ecosystem incentives.

Just back on August 22, new wallets were conducting issuance tests on the Robinhood chain.

A DEV wallet transferred in 300 ETH 4 hours ago and created two $WWW tokens back to back. The first iteration set a 10% tax fee, while the second set it to 0.3%.

Full name: Truth Coin (Truth Coin).

Rumors are circulating that a launch tied to Trump / the Trump family on the Robinhood chain is dropping this weekend.

Since Trump is a sitting President, an official token launch directly by him isn't possible, but there are legal loopholes for his family to launch one.

Do you guys think these rumors are legit and is it worth prepping a bag for this?
